# The Ripsaw

*The sawbills' great one, longer than a fishing boat, lies up under the Old Cut's broken sea gates, scarred end to end, and the shoal follows it. It rears out of the Gullet to strike along the towpath; watch its saw and the tide when it turns. Potions work in the Gullet Gates; scrolls do not.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Boss | [The Ripsaw](../monsters/ripsaw.md) |
| Arena | [The Gullet Gates](../maps/gullet_gates.md) |

- Entered by talking to [Old Lock Post](../npcs/gullet_gate_post.md)
